title: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27689v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language model (VLM)-based agents offer a promising approach to robotic manipulation, yet remain limited by inadequate memory organization, uncertain failure attribution, and limited reuse of execution experience. We propose Embodied-Harness, a dual-agent framework that improves manipulation by refining the execution harness without updating model parameters. The Actor interacts with the environment through a robot-control interface, while the Reflector converts execution evidence into reusable operational guidance. Hierarchical Memory Architecture maintains short-term execution context and long-term experiential knowledge to support execution and reflection. Evidence-based Experience Reflection grounds failure diagnosis in observed interactions, while Recursive Harness Self-Improvement refines operational guidance across successive attempts. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RoboSPA, and RMBench demonstrate the effectiveness of Embo

translated_title: Embodied-Harness：迈向机器人操作的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的智能体为机器人操作提供了一种有前景的方法，但仍然受限于记忆组织不足、失败归因不确定以及执行经验复用有限等问题。我们提出 Embodied-Harness，这是一个双智能体框架，通过改进执行框架本身而不更新模型参数来提升操作能力。Actor（执行者）通过机器人控制接口与环境交互，而 Reflector（反思者）将执行证据转化为可复用的操作指导。分层记忆架构维护短期执行上下文与长期经验知识，以同时支持执行和反思。基于证据的经验反思将失败诊断建立在观察到的交互之上，而递归框架自我改进则在连续多次尝试中不断完善操作指导。在 RoboTwin 2.0、RoboSPA 和 RMBench 上的实验证明了 Embodied-Harness 的有效性。
tldr: 提出双智能体框架 Embodied-Harness，通过分层记忆、基于证据的经验反思与递归自我改进，在不更新模型参数的情况下提升机器人操作能力。
en_tdlr: Embodied-Harness is a dual-agent framework that improves robotic manipulation without updating model parameters, via hierarchical memory, evidence-based experience reflection, and recursive harness self-improvement.
